summary: Moves the ci-wait wait into a store-free concord ci-wait CLI verb that polls, enforces the 1800-second deadline from durable state, classifies terminal outcomes from observed results, judges only the commit a caller names for a pull request and supersedes a later head change, and reports gh failures as explicit errors. The utility allowance narrows to the verb and the model-maintained poll loop is removed.
title: The ci-wait utility delegates its wait to a deterministic CLI verb
